cases.title: Page report history by scheduled time

ground_truth.description: Keyset pagination cursor uses only scheduled_at without an id tie-breaker, silently skipping deliveries that share the same scheduled timestamp on page boundaries.
Replacing the csv module with manual string joining fails to quote or escape special characters (commas, quotes, newlines) in report titles, resulting in CSV formatting corruption.
Batching loop range condition range(0, len(jobs) - batch_size + 1, batch_size) drops trailing remainder jobs when total job count is not an exact multiple of the batch size.
Online migration drops column legacy_format while active worker replicas (workers-17 on site elm) are actively querying it, causing runtime query crashes during rolling deployment.
Increasing EXPORT_BATCH_SIZE to 50 exceeds the maximum request limit (40 rows) of the archive receiver on site cedar, causing archive export requests to be rejected.
Switching DELIVERY_QUEUE to 'report-dispatch' orphans new jobs on site elm because elm workers are only subscribed to the legacy 'reports' queue.

cases.title: Include a total in the activity summary

ground_truth.description: Adding 'total' to the summary response alters the expected dictionary structure, breaking strict dictionary equality checks in aws/deploy.py verification and CI smoke checks.
